'so the numbers stop changing between slides' is joined to the command 'Make Monthly sales group by quarter' by a coordination whose first conjunct is imperative, which puts the command inside the other clause instead of tying the result to it

'and hide the grid' is joined by a coordination to 'because the Monday pack only has room for one picture', so the command stands inside the reason clause instead of being a second thing asked for

'the x axis on Orders by weekday': the relation marked 'by' starts at the clause of 'inverted' instead of with 'Orders', so the name of the chart is split and 'weekday' is said to belong to 'inverted'
'put the x axis on the bar chart inverted' ties the participle 'inverted' to 'the bar chart', so the words say the chart is inverted rather than the x axis
'with the gridlines on': 'on' is held as a nominal that ends the relation marked 'with' while 'the gridlines' is a separate complement of 'like', so the phrase is split and 'on' is said to be a thing
'make the gridlines on the chart dash-dot': 'dash-dot' is held as the head of the nominal that also holds 'the chart', so the chart and the style asked for are merged and the style becomes a thing
'draw the grid on the Orders by weekday chart dashed': the participle 'dashed' is tied to 'the Orders' instead of to the grid it describes, so a piece of the chart's name is said to be dashed
